requiredBeforeFilingDefect.cause: SHARED DELAWARE WIRING, not this family's own map. The row is produced by petitionMap() in scripts/census-v1-de-expungement/de-superior-court-forms.mjs through the h.election() helper in mapHelpers() in scripts/census-v1-de-expungement/de-expungement-core.mjs, and that helper hardcodes requiredBeforeFiling: false. petitionMap() is imported by BOTH scripts/build-census-v1-de_pardon_expungement-set.mjs and scripts/build-census-v1-de_discretionary_superior_court-set.mjs, which is why the same blank failed the Superior Court sibling.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.whyTheHelperWasWrongHere: h.election() is the right classification for a control the route leaves open AND the form leaves optional -- the three county venue boxes and the two interpreter boxes, which VF03 confirmed sound and which this repair does not touch. It is the wrong classification for a blank the printed page marks MUST. requiredBeforeFiling false is also what keeps a blank out of the participant guide's "items you must supply" table, so one wrong flag produced both halves of the defect: the misclassification and the silence.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.repair: A new helper, h.requiredElection(), was added beside h.election() in de-expungement-core.mjs for a control the FORM ITSELF marks required. It carries requiredBeforeFiling true, disposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, identity and participantMustSupply, and keeps isSelectionControl true because the blank is a checkbox. petitionMap() now declares the manifest-injustice box through it. Nothing else in either module changed classification.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.contractPathTakenAndWhy: classifyField() reads a selection control as fieldClass SELECTION_CONTROL / requirement PARTICIPANT_ELECTION, which is not in PARTICIPANT_COMPLETABLE_REQUIREMENTS, so a bare requiredBeforeFiling declaration on a checkbox returns UNCLASSIFIED_BLANK. The helper therefore reaches REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING through the contract's own case-determined exception (determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute with a stated whyTheRouteCannotDetermineIt), which exists for exactly this shape: an election the CASE and not the ROUTE decides. Verified in isolation against scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/completeness-contract.mjs before rebuilding -- classifyBlank returned disposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, fieldClass SELECTION_CONTROL, requiresParticipantDisclosure true.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.secondCauseFoundWhileRepairing: countCompleteness()'s row() in de-expungement-core.mjs projected only disposition, requiredBeforeFiling, routeDetermined, identity and factId onto the declared channel classifyBlank reads. determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute and whyTheRouteCannotDetermineIt were dropped, which would have silently converted the corrected declaration back into an unclassified blank. Both keys are now passed through. This is a latent defect for ANY family on this core that ever needs the case-determined exception, not only Delaware.

Enumerating the four forms' page-1 caption rules from the committed census: Judicial District -- EXP102 ink 0.00 REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, EXP106 ink 0.00 REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, FEE102 ink 0.00 REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, EXP104 ink 0.70 NOT_A_FIELD. requiredBeforeFilingDefect.causeOfTheEXP104Instance: inkOnRule() decides a rule is an underline when a printed line inside its vertical window covers half its width, and the window scales with that line's own font size (line.y <= rule.y + size * 1.3). EXP104 page 1's 14.04-point heading "State of Minnesota   District Court" reaches 18.25 points down, and TWO rules sit inside that reach: the one 3.46 points below it, which it genuinely underlines, and the Judicial District rule 16.66 points below it, which it does not. The heading's words "District Court" span x 418-535, the same span as the Judicial District rule, giving 81.82 points of ink over a 116.4-point rule = 0.703. Over 0.5 the blank becomes underlined_printed_text, and decideBlank() returns NOT_A_FIELD on construction BEFORE the caption band is ever consulted. Measured directly with the builder's own rulesOfPage and groupIntoLines against the bound EXP104 source.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.repairOfTheEXP104Instance: A rule cannot underline text that has another rule between it and the text. inkOnRule() now ignores a candidate line when a second horizontal rule lies between the two and overlaps this rule's x span. It can only ever remove a false underline, never a true one, because a true underline has nothing between it and its text.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.causeOfTheFEE102Instance: captionBandDecision() matched on the printed caption alone, so /^case type$/ returned the same NOT_A_FIELD sentence -- "the form prints its own answer, Criminal, on this rule" -- for all four forms. On FEE102 that sentence is contradicted by the build's own measurement of the same rule: ink 0.00, nothing printed there.
requiredBeforeFilingDefect.repairOfTheFEE102Instance: The Case Type decision now reads the measured ink. A rule that carries printed ink keeps NOT_A_FIELD with the unchanged reason; a rule that carries none becomes REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with the same shape of instruction the Plaintiff/Petitioner line on the same caption already uses: FEE102 prints no case type, the three court forms all print Criminal on their own faces, copy it exactly as EXP102 prints it.
